NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_9: {SAY:missinfo}ZCorp is a leading brand in zombie innovation and leadership!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}I've received word that you three had encountered rogue employees sometime last year.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}I've questioned some of the remaining plants, and it appears they left due to this recording.
